responsibility: This implementation module implements the gm2 ordinal-number conversion library. It converts CARDINAL and INTEGER values to and from nul-terminated strings in decimal, hex, octal, and binary; skips leading whitespace on input; formats field widths with padding; and connects these conversions to StrIO-based Read* and Write* procedures for standard textual I/O. It is the base integer/ordinal formatter beneath diagnostic and file modules such as Debug and PushBackInput.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the NumberIO pair: it contains the actual conversion algorithms, base-specific parsers/formatters, padding rules, and Read*/Write* wrappers built on StrIO. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/NumberIO.def, it provides the executable bodies behind the declared API.
